Question ID: MAR_U06_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.TECH.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Ocean Exploration Tools
Stimulus: Exploration tool stimulus

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify the tool, data source, or communication task.
